name: trace_android_references
description: Trace incoming static references to an exact Android class or unique method. Overloaded method reference queries are explicitly unsupported by the current engine. Source lines and DEX offsets remain unknown; no runtime calls are inferred.

__schema0.description: Local APK path; the target is never executed

__schema2.description: Omit for class references; ambiguous overloaded methods are unsupported

method_name.description: Omit for class references; ambiguous overloaded methods are unsupported

path.description: Local APK path; the target is never executed
